text:
Corvane Motors has put the range of its E3 delivery van at 290 kilometres, according to the company's Corvane E3 Technical Specification Sheet, Rev. 2, published on 14 March 2025.

The document was released at the Northmere Commercial Vehicle Expo. It states that the figure is supported by a usable battery capacity of 78 kWh.

Halvard Okonkwo-Reyes, chief powertrain engineer at Corvane Motors, is named in connection with the vehicle's powertrain. The specification sheet presents the 290-kilometre range as the van's stated figure, and the 78 kWh capacity as the basis for it.

The sheet is the company's own published statement of the E3's performance. It is the document on which this report relies for both the range and the battery capacity. No other range figure appears in the material cited here.

Corvane Motors has not published any alternative range figure for the E3.
